snippet.title: Baptized in Dismay – Leaked Trailer
snippet.description:
Baptized in Dismay is still in early development, 
what you’ll see is just an initial taste of the game’s darkness.

Something has slipped through... fragments of a broken, dark world.

This footage does not represent the final version of the game.

Follow the project:
https://linktr.ee/baptizedindismay
“Where pain takes form, hope is born.”

Made by Amos Shade Srl, Baptized in Dismay™
KICKSTARTER IN COMING
